name: Segmented control
summary: A radio group styled as a bar of options, for picking one of two to five choices.
description: Use it to switch a view or setting, such as monthly or yearly billing. It is a form control: the value submits with the form. For switching between panels of content, use tabs.

classes.name: v-segmented
classes.description: On a <fieldset>. Each option is a <label> holding a radio and a <span> for the text. Scrolls sideways if the options do not fit.

states.description: The selected radio: its span gets the raised surface and a shadow.
All radios share one name, which makes them a single group with one value.

keyboard.action: Moves focus into the group, onto the selected option, and out again.
Selects the next option (native radio behaviour).

a11y: Give the fieldset a <legend>; hide it with .v-sr-only if the bar is labelled visually some other way.
Real radio inputs sit over each option, so screen readers announce "radio button, 1 of 3" with no ARIA needed.
The selected option differs by surface and shadow as well as text colour, and the focus ring shows on the option span.
